cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — dries her hair with a towel; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; an indoor lap pool with lane ropes — standing; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — looks into a small brass telescope; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; overgrown jungle temple ruins — standing
